Name: Arknights Bunny
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
[size=4][b]我将四种山山兔加入了星露谷！他们分别是[color=#7f6000]阿米娅[/color]、[color=#6aa84f]凯尔希[/color]和[color=#f4cccc]特雷西娅[/color]！[/b][/size]以及一只伪装成兔子的恐怖[color=#ff0000]血狼[/color](笑
[size=4][b]I've added four Arknights-style bunnies to Stardew Valley! They are [color=#f1c232]Amiya[/color], [color=#b6d7a8]Kal'tsit[/color], and [color=#f4cccc]Teresia[/color]! [/b][/size]Plus a[color=#ff0000] BloodyWolf[/color] disguised as a bunny.

[size=3]兔子们需要三天成长，之后每天生产：
[/size][size=3]阿米娅兔(3000g)：胡萝卜、星露谷年历、谜之盒、兔子的脚、珍珠
凯尔希兔(5000g)：放射性鲤鱼、放射性矿石、放射性矿锭、虚空蛋、虚空蛋黄酱、虚空精华、虚空鲑鱼、史莱姆鱼、生命药水、石化史莱姆
特雷西娅兔(30000g)：星之果茶、星之书、巧克力蛋糕、粉红蛋糕、交友导论、葡萄干、果酱、魔法糖冰棍
皿良皮车(7990g，每三天生产)：一个能加799攻击力的一个超级胡萝卜。[/size]

[size=3]The bunnies take three days to mature and then produce daily:
Amiya Bunny (3000g): Carrots, Stardew Valley Almanac, Mystery Box, Rabbit's Foot, Pearl
Kal'tsit Bunny (5000g): Radioactive Carp, Radioactive Ore, Radioactive Bar, Void Egg, Void Mayonnaise, Void Essence, Void Salmon, Slimejack, Life Elixir, Petrified Slime
Teresia Bunny (30000g): Stardrop Tea, Purple Book, Chocolate Cake, Pink Cake, Book of Friendship, Raisins, Jam, Magic Sugar Ice Pop
BloodyWolf (7990g, produces every three days): A super carrot that grants +799 attack power.
[/size]
